e2e/focus-not-obscured.e2e.ts (WCAG 2.4.11) covers three pages today — button, dialog, drawer; this page joins when that suite's population grows (tracked in ecoma-io/loom#308)

exceptions.because: file-upload.e2e.ts drives the file input directly — the browse control's keyboard contract is unproven in browser
